sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a post-trained vision-language model with 9B parameters, 32 layers, and a Gated DeltaNet plus Gated Attention hybrid layout, built for multimodal instruction-following and tool calling, with 262,144 native context length and stated extensibility up to about 1,010,000 tokens.

sources.snippet: Qwen3: Alibaba's Latest Open-Source AI Model Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models (LLMs) from Alibaba Cloud. Built by the team behind the Tongyi Qianwen series (通义千问), this release brings serious power and flexibility, packed into an Apache-2.0-licensed, open-source package. sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.
